why: The literal conjecture (Williamson matrices exist for every order) was already disproven pre-snapshot in 1993 (order 35 counterexample), which is itself a pre-snapshot finding worth flagging since the list appears stale. Post-2024 work (a May 2026 paper on 'near Williamson matrices' up to order 63, and an August 2026 Claude-assisted search for 'Hadamard matrices of Williamson type' at specific orders like 668) is active, but it is unclear whether these concern the Williamson conjecture's own statement (existence for all n, already settled) versus variant/generalized definitions or the parent Hadamard conjecture, so I could not confidently classify it as this problem moving versus a neighboring/variant problem.
